steps.title: From clocking in to CIAO in four steps

items.title: Clock in
items.body: The worker opens their personal Clock Point link and clocks in. After a one-time pairing, the home-screen icon is enough — no app, no login.

items.title: Start the customer visit
items.body: At the customer site the worker taps ‘start working’. The GPS check confirms they are really there — that counts as the CIAO check-in right away.

items.title: New customer on the road
items.body: Enter name and address; the phone sets the pin automatically. If the customer already exists under a slightly different name, a suggestion appears instead of a duplicate.

items.title: Break, switch, clock out
items.body: Breaks and customer switches follow the same flow. Every change becomes a correct CIAO registration — nobody has to remember anything.

places.title: Cleaning now, construction once the RSZ scope is live
places.lead: Checkmate starts with cleaning and maintenance in immovable property for third parties (Article 30bis). The same pipeline is prepared for works in immovable state — it goes live with the official RSZ specifications.
items: cleaning offices and shared areas
maintenance and repairs at customer sites
construction sites — once the RSZ construction scope is live
jobs for private individuals, where no DDT entry is needed
places.close: The worker has nothing to remember: starting and stopping at the customer is the registration.

items.body: Clock in, start the customer visit, break and clock out on your own phone. No app, no login, no hassle.

items.title: For the owner
items.body: See live who works where, which customer visits took place and which registrations the RSZ confirmed. You manage customers and work addresses yourself.

items.title: For your records

No payroll, no Dimona, no duplicate files — just correct presence.
